Built-in Help, and Windows notifications from the notification area.

### What's changed
- **Help.** Choose **Help** in the sidebar, or press **F1**, for a step-by-step guide to every part of the program, with search. The same guide is on GitHub.
- **Windows notifications.** With **Desktop notifications** on (Settings > Operator & alerts), the program shows a Windows notification, even while its window is closed, when:
  - all the cards are printed,
  - the printer needs attention while cards are waiting,
  - a card doesn't print,
  - cards need checking after a restart.

  Click a notification to open the print queue.
- If the PC restarts or the printer is unplugged mid-print, nothing is lost: the queue shows which card to check, then carries on from the next card when you choose **Resume printing**. The new Help explains the steps.
- The example in Settings > Appearance > Company name now reads "e.g. Example Company".

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.6 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.6.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
